publisher_call.code: RootlessRoutePublisher(ProxyOperations(Settings.from_env('internal', env={SPANEL_PROXY_CONFIG_DIR, SPANEL_PROXY_CERT_RESOLVER=internal, SPANEL_PROXY_ENTRYPOINT_HTTP=web, SPANEL_PROXY_ENTRYPOINT_HTTPS=websecure, SPANEL_PROXY_TRANSPORT=local}), build_runner(settings))).publish('gitea-e2e.lab', '172.25.0.1', 40062, https=True)

route_yaml:
# managed-by: spanel
http:
  routers:
    spanel-gitea-e2e-lab-route-path-1-http:
      rule: (Host(`gitea-e2e.lab`)) && !PathPrefix(`/.well-known/acme-challenge/`)
      entryPoints:
      - web
      middlewares:
      - spanel-gitea-e2e-lab-route-path-1-redirect
      service: spanel-gitea-e2e-lab-route-path-1
      priority: 301
    spanel-gitea-e2e-lab-route-path-1:
      rule: Host(`gitea-e2e.lab`)
      entryPoints:
      - websecure
      service: spanel-gitea-e2e-lab-route-path-1
      priority: 401
      tls:
        certResolver: internal
  middlewares:
    spanel-gitea-e2e-lab-route-path-1-redirect:
      redirectScheme:
        scheme: https
        permanent: true
  services:
    spanel-gitea-e2e-lab-route-path-1:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
        - url: http://172.25.0.1:40062

certificate.subject: CN = gitea-e2e.lab
certificate.issuer: O = Spanel Lab CA, CN = Spanel Lab CA Intermediate CA
certificate.verify_detail: openssl verify -untrusted intermediate_ca.crt -CAfile root_ca.crt leaf.pem => OK (chain depth2 Root CA); nota: root_ca.crt solo no contiene la intermediate, se verificó con lab_ca_bundle.crt y con -untrusted intermediate_ca.crt

checks.name: yaml_generated_by_publisher
checks.detail: router HTTP con redirectScheme permanente y exclusion !PathPrefix(`/.well-known/acme-challenge/`); router websecure con tls.certResolver: internal; backend http://172.25.0.1:40062. Generado por RootlessRoutePublisher.publish, no a mano.

checks.name: cert_issued_by_internal_resolver
checks.command: echo | openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:443 -servername gitea-e2e.lab -CAfile ca/root_ca.crt | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -ext subjectAltName
checks.output: subject=CN = gitea-e2e.lab; issuer=O = Spanel Lab CA, CN = Spanel Lab CA Intermediate CA; SAN: DNS:gitea-e2e.lab

checks.name: chain_verifies_against_lab_root
checks.output: /tmp/leaf0106.pem: OK (depth2: CN = Spanel Lab CA Root CA)

checks.name: acme_tls_alpn_validation_success
checks.output: 16:51:19 ERR primer intento (status=pending, DNS del lab aun sin gitea-e2e.lab) -> 16:51:20 'The server validated our request' -> 16:51:29 'Server responded with a certificate'; emisor step-ca (Spanel Lab CA Intermediate CA)

gaps: El DNS del lab (dnsmasq spanel-lab-dns, hosts en scripts/traefik-lab/dns/hosts) no tenia gitea-e2e.lab: el primer intento TLS-ALPN-01 quedo pending y fallo a los ~8 min. Se agrego '172.25.0.3 gitea-e2e.lab' al hosts del lab y se SIGHUP a dnsmasq; el reintento automatico de Traefik emitio el cert sin reiniciar nada. Un host nuevo via publisher requiere darlo de alta en el DNS del lab (o resolverlo) para TLS-ALPN-01.
ca/root_ca.crt no incluye la intermediate: la verificacion del chain necesita lab_ca_bundle.crt o -untrusted intermediate_ca.crt (limitacion preexistente del lab, no del publisher).
El YAML manual spanel-route-0105-gitea.yml (solo HTTP) se movio a scripts/traefik-lab/backup-0106/ para no duplicar el Host; la ruta HTTPS generada por el publisher quedo publicada en su lugar.
rollback: restaurar el YAML de backup-0106 (mv spanel-route-0105-gitea.yml de vuelta a dynamic/) y ejecutar RootlessRoutePublisher(operations).unpublish('gitea-e2e.lab') (o borrar spanel-route-45fb306f00382472d3eb.yml); esperar la recarga del file-provider
final_state: Ruta HTTPS de gitea-e2e.lab publicada y operativa (301 en web, 200 en websecure); spanel-route-0105-gitea.yml respaldado en scripts/traefik-lab/backup-0106/
